name: Leeds Bradford Airport
title: Leeds Bradford Airport guide: terminals, airlines and getting there
intro: Leeds Bradford has one terminal and no train station. Here's who flies from it and how to get there from Leeds, Bradford and Harrogate.

terminals.name: The terminal
terminals.airlines: Jet2 (the biggest), Ryanair, TUI and others
terminals.text: One terminal with one security area. Jet2's early-morning wave makes 5am to 7am the busiest time.

sections.heading: Getting to Leeds Bradford Airport
sections.text:
- **Bus:** Flyer buses run from Leeds and Bradford city centres, and there are buses from Harrogate too.
- **Car:** the airport is north-west of Leeds, on the A658. Roads around it are narrow and get busy, so allow extra time. There's a charge for the drop-off zone.

faqs.question: Is there a train station at Leeds Bradford Airport?
faqs.answer: No. Take a Flyer bus from Leeds or Bradford city centre.
